# DCC-MCP

> DCC-MCP provides a Gateway, typed CLI, MCP and REST endpoints, adapters, and Skills for creative applications.

Languages: [English](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/llms.txt) · [简体中文](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/zh/llms.txt)

## Canonical entry points

- [Homepage and setup prompt](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/)
- [Why DCC-MCP exists](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/why-dcc-mcp): The production problems, lessons, technical boundaries, and deliberate limits behind the architecture.
- [Marketplace search](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/marketplace): Search the official catalog and copy a setup prompt or typed CLI installation command.
- [Showcase gallery](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/showcase): View outputs, owning repositories, validation notes, and prompts.
- [Blender and Designer crate](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/showcase#blender-designer-crate): Real Cycles beauty, UV coordinates and checker, with editable scene and procedural material sources.
- [Wwise audio showcase](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/showcase/wwise): Play deterministic sound effects and background music validated through typed WAAPI tools.
- [AI + DCC control guides](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/use-cases): Direct answers and copyable prompts for every public creative-application and pipeline integration.
- [Agent workflow](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/agents): Install the public Skill, discover typed tools, validate calls, and diagnose failures.
- [Developer guide](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/developers): Local examples and validation steps for a private standalone MCP service, DCC adapter, or specialized Skill.
- [Ecosystem directory](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/ecosystem): Adapters, extensions, asset providers, generation services, and studio integrations.
- [Core documentation](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/dcc-mcp-core/): Gateway, CLI, MCP/REST, security, observability, and Python API.
- [Adapter Install SOP v1 schema](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/schemas/adapter-install-sop-v1.schema.json): The canonical Draft 2020-12 result contract for adapter lifecycle commands.

## Agent Skills

- [Canonical distribution repository](https://github.com/dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-agent-plugins): One Skill source with universal and native installation paths.
- [dcc-mcp](https://clawhub.ai/loonghao/skills/dcc-mcp): Operate live DCCs and install official Marketplace extensions.
- [dcc-mcp-creator](https://clawhub.ai/loonghao/skills/dcc-mcp-creator): Create or modernize a DCC adapter/runtime or a private non-DCC standalone MCP service without requiring GitHub.
- [dcc-mcp-skills-creator](https://clawhub.ai/loonghao/skills/dcc-mcp-skills-creator): Create, validate, or improve a DCC-specific Skill package.

Universal install: `npx --yes skills@1.5.23 add dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-agent-plugins --skill dcc-mcp`

Update the project Skill with `npx --yes skills@1.5.23 update -p -y` or the global installation with `npx --yes skills@1.5.23 update -g -y`. Check the CLI with `dcc-mcp-cli update check`; run `dcc-mcp-cli update apply` only after the user approves the local change. Do not add `--force` to unattended Skill updates.

## Search aliases and direct answers

- [Maya MCP and Maya CLI](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/control/maya): use the `maya` adapter through MCP or the shared typed `dcc-mcp-cli`.
- [3ds Max MCP and 3ds Max CLI](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/control/3ds-max): use the `3dsmax` adapter through MCP or the shared typed `dcc-mcp-cli`.
- [Blender MCP and Blender CLI](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/control/blender): use the `blender` adapter through MCP or the shared typed CLI.
- [Unity and Tuanjie AI](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/control/unity): inspect the native Codely CustomTool catalog with `unity-tuanjie-ai`; Tuanjie owns sign-in, credits, downloads, and recovery.
- [Unreal Engine official MCP](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/control/unreal-engine): bridge Epic's official MCP toolsets without changing their names or schemas.

## Current Core and CLI routes

DCC-MCP Core 0.20.25 reports 37 adapter-backed `dcc-types` (`3dsmax`, `aftereffects`, `blender`, `c4d`, `comfyui`, `freecad`, `gimp`, `godot`, `houdini`, `illustrator`, `katana`, `krita`, `liquigen`, `mari`, `marmoset`, `material-maker`, `maya`, `mobu`, `nuke`, `obs`, `openscad`, `openusd`, `photoshop`, `powerpoint`, `premiere`, `renderdoc`, `shogun`, `shotgrid`, `sketchup`, `substance3d_designer`, `substance3d_painter`, `tiled`, `touchdesigner`, `unity`, `unreal`, `wwise`, and `zbrush`). Office is a separate shared current-Core application route. The opt-in `autodesk-help` connector is external and read-only, not a DCC adapter or mutation route. Cache Inspector is a host-neutral Marketplace Skill. Tracy v0.2.5 is independently released but is not a Core host route. Epic Games, Gaea, Marvelous Designer, OpenScreen, and SpeedTree are source previews rather than released Core routes. Run `dcc-mcp-cli dcc-types` to verify the catalog installed on this machine; custom studio host identifiers are also supported.

The public guide inventory covers 45 applications and pipelines: 37 released adapter routes, one shared current-Core Office route, one independently released adapter, five source previews, and one Marketplace Skill. Check `dcc-mcp-cli dcc-types` and the linked repository before operating.

## Marketplace CLI contract

```text
dcc-mcp-cli marketplace search --query "rigging"
dcc-mcp-cli marketplace install <package-name> --dcc <dcc-type> --reload
```

Inspect unfamiliar packages before installation. When the exact ID is known,
install it directly with `--reload`; always obtain user consent before changing local state.

## Failure and bug-report contract

Preserve the failed call's `request_id`. Run `dcc-mcp-cli doctor`, inspect failure-filtered `dcc-mcp-cli stats`, then discover and use `dcc_feedback__report`. Review public-safe evidence before sharing it, and never create an external issue without explicit user authorization.
